warehouse_grid — DRIVE agv op

• Data kinds: none → any (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.warehouse_grid(n_rack_rows=3, n_rack_cols=4, rack_len=4, aisle=1, margin=2) (to call the implementation directly, import agvfleet; agvfleet.warehouse_grid(n_rack_rows=3, n_rack_cols=4, rack_len=4, aisle=1, margin=2); from the registry, opsdrive.get("warehouse_grid"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

棚の列と通路でできた倉庫の格子(True = 走れる)。

棚は横長の 1 行 × rack_len マスのブロックで、上下左右を幅 aisle の通路が囲む。外周に margin マスの走行帯(ステーションの前)を置く。返りは (grid, info)、info に棚のマスの一覧と外周の帯。
